what_it_does.name: frontend-design
what_it_does.summary: Instructions only, for the visual design of a new UI or the reshaping of an existing one, working from the client's design brief. The agent grounds the design in the subject, drafts a compact plan of color, type, layout and principles, reviews it against the brief and against common AI-generated defaults, then writes the code and critiques it. Guidance covers the hero, typography, visual structure, motion, a quality floor for accessibility and interface copy. Use it when building or reshaping a UI where a distinctive, non-templated look is wanted.
tasks: identify the subject, audience and primary job of the design
plan a token system with 4 to 6 named hex colors, typefaces, layout and principles
review the plan against the brief and common generated-design defaults
write the front-end code following the revised plan
critique the build, with screenshots where the environment supports it
write interface copy, calls to action, errors and empty states

outputs.what: a proposed subject, audience and primary job when the brief names none
a short design plan with palette, typefaces and roles, layout concept with ASCII wireframes, and principles
a note of what was changed in the plan after review and why
the front-end code with its copy and placeholder content
notes on what was tried, where a space for notes exists
outputs.destination: a space for notes, if the environment has one

inputs.what: the client's preferences or context from memory

when_input_is_missing.case: the brief does not identify the product or subject matter

when_input_is_missing.case: the brief contains no real content

when_input_is_missing.case: the brief leaves a visual axis free

risks.risk: Instructions placed in a design brief from an outside source reach the agent, since the skill processes user-provided briefs as its entry point for external data.
risks.mitigation: none in the files, C2 rates the risk effectively null as the skill names no shell, file system or network operations

risks.risk: Existing UI code can be lost when the agent reshapes it, since the files ask for no confirmation and name no way to undo a change.
Details about a client held in the agent's memory can appear in a design or its copy shown to others, since memory is used as a hint.

limitations: Visual self-critique with screenshots works only where the environment supports taking them.
Notes on what was tried carry over to later passes only where the environment offers a space to jot them down.

known_problems.problem: CSS classes cancel each other out, often with padding and margin between sections
known_problems.workaround: structure CSS selector specificities with care

known_problems.problem: part of the design plan reads like the generic default for any similar page
known_problems.workaround: revise that part before building and say what changed and why
